summary_en: NOK Group cancelled 14,812,559 treasury shares (7.28% of shares outstanding before cancellation) on October 1, 2026. The shares arose from a in-kind dividend by subsidiary NOK Corporation, which held Eagle Industries shares that converted into parent company shares upon the October 1 establishment of NOK Group as a holding company through joint stock transfer.
title_en: Notice regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, NOK Group resolved to cancel 14,812,559 treasury shares representing 7.28% of shares outstanding (before cancellation), reducing issued shares from 203,416,624 to 188,604,065. The cancellation followed a corporate reorganization in which NOK Group was established as a holding company through joint stock transfer of NOK Corporation and Eagle Industries.

The treasury shares arose from an in-kind dividend by subsidiary NOK Corporation, which previously held 14,812,559 shares of Eagle Industries. Under Japanese corporate law, a 100% subsidiary of a listed company cannot hold shares in its parent company. To resolve this structural issue, NOK Corporation made a distribution of those shares to the parent company, converting them to treasury stock.

NOK Group operates under a policy of cancelling treasury shares that lack designated uses, such as in compensation programs. The company therefore resolved to cancel these shares on the date of the board resolution. Settlement is expected to complete within a few business days.
